[[File:ChrisCorrpedo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A B1 battle droid rides a Chriscorrpedo]]
The '''chriscorrpedoes''' were a pair of weapons fired at the ''[[Charm's Way]]'' by a [[Lupus-class missile frigate|Trade Federation Missile Frigate]].<ref name="SWS">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref> A [[Cowboy Droid]]<ref name="Gamer4">{{GamerCite|4|State of the Arts}}</ref> rode the exterior of one of the projectiles.<ref name="SWS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The chriscorrpedoes were named after [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]{{'s}} lead programmer, [[Chris Corry]].<ref name="Gamer4" />
